name: multi_indicator_consensus_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, intraday algorithmic TWAP flows create sustained directional sessions where short-term pullbacks are systematically absorbed. When a pullback within a bullish session (close still above session VWAP) drives RSI below 40 and Stochastic below 30 simultaneously — while MACD remains above its signal line and volume surges on the recovery bar — it indicates that the selling flow has exhausted against resting institutional buy orders and price is snapping back to trend. The 2-bar persistence requirement (10 seconds) on the consensus score filters 5-second spikes from genuine multi-indicator convergence, which on NIFTY typically precedes 10-20 spot point continuation moves driven by algo re-entry at these exhaustion levels.
core_signal_oneliner: At least 4 of 5 indicators (VWAP, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, VROC) simultaneously aligned for 10 consecutive seconds, confirming pullback exhaustion and trend resumption
